bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the alignment (F1 scores) of LLM-based evaluators with human annotator judgments across 10 diverse languages (English, French, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic, Bengali, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Swahili) to identify performance disparities in non-English evaluation.

Evaluating whether LLM judges (like GPT-4) assign disproportionately higher ratings to summaries generated by their own underlying models compared to summaries generated by other models (e.g., mT5, PaLM) using the overlapping SEAHORSE dataset.

Analyzing the class distribution of LLM predicted evaluation scores (0, 1, or 2) compared to human aggregates to observe if the models disproportionately favor the middle of the rating scale (e.g., GPT-3.5-Turbo predicting class 1).
